description: Real GeneratedModel metadata for the default JewelryDefinition, produced by running build_solitaire_ring() directly during Sprint 5. Not invented. Volumes and the bounding box are OCCT boolean/tessellation results and were empirically observed (via CI, on a different OS/OCCT build than the value below was generated on) to differ from this exact figure starting around the 9th-10th significant digit — this is the real, previously-hypothesized cross-platform reproducibility gap documented in docs/bible/07-atlas/137-determinism-and-reproducibility.md (ATLAS-OQ-009). backend/tests/test_atlas_registry.py compares these fields with a relative tolerance (1e-6) rather than exact equality for this reason; definitionHash, generatorVersion, and generatedProngCount are pure-Python values and are still compared exactly.
note: totalProductionMetalVolume (341.44334316909976) is NOT the arithmetic sum of the pre-fuse band+prongs+basket_support volumes (250.99168317654699 + 29.650351464580467 + 83.15575842566426 = 363.7977930667917), because combined_metal is the FUSED solid, not a sum of independent volumes — fusing removes the overlapping embedded regions (EMBED_MM=0.4mm intrusions used to guarantee genuine 3D contact). The difference, 363.7977930667917 - 341.44334316909976 = 22.35444989769195 mm3, is the volume of mutual overlap removed by the boolean union. This is expected and documented in docs/bible/07-atlas/142-volume-and-bounding-box-inspection.md.
